summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #39. Solver parity corpus committed byte-identical from viamin/color_matching priv/parity/v1 (12 scenarios incl. 5 tie cases, 3 exclusion cases, unknown-weight case) with a full parity suite over WeightedSquaredErrorScorer + CompositionSolver; an independent replay reproduced all 12 scenarios exactly (no divergence). PaletteAPIClient migration contract tests pin request shape, token handling, error mapping, and wire decoding. Migration guard tests are red by construction (no committed OpenAPI document, no swift-openapi-generator/-runtime in Package.swift) - implementation lands in the follow-up run. No Swift toolchain exists in this Linux container, so swift test could not be executed here; CI is the executor of record.
